hero.caption: A U.S. Air Force North American F-100F-10-NA Super Sabre aircraft (s/n 56-3882) of the 416th Tactical Fighter Squadron, 37th Tactical Fighter Wing at Phu Cat air base, South Vietnam. The 416th TFS operated from Phu Cat with F-100s from 15 April 1967 to 27 May 1969. The F-100Fs were used in the forward air controller role. The F-100F 56-3882 was finally retired to the MASDC on 7 September 1979 as FE0591.
